title: Study of Atorvastatin/Fenofibrate (LCP-AtorFen) Combination Therapy in Dyslipidemia

sections.abstract:
The current study is designed to test the efficacy, safety and tolerability of LCP-AtorFen, a combination of atorvastatin and fenofibrate.

Posted outcomes: Percent Changes From Baseline to End-of-treatment in Non-HDL Cholesterol, HDL Cholesterol, and Triglycerides by LCP-AtorFen Versus Atorvastatin Monotherapy. timeframe=baseline(randomization) to 12 weeks. LCP-AtorFen 40/100mg=-44.8 (±16.2); Atorvastatin 40mg=-40.2 (±17.3)
